gripper.note: Both 7-joint arm chains match the existing x2_ultra.urdf kinematic origins and axes. Fixed center links are explicit in the source.

hand.note: The companion URDF has no fixed grasp/TCP link. Both middle finger flexion roots are approximately 160 mm along wrist -Z; index roots are approximately 141 mm. Positive finger flexion curls toward wrist +X. The application estimates a cup grasp center at wrist [0.035, 0, -0.150] m. Orientation retains the companion MJCF palm frame Rx(3.14). This is not a measured calibration and does not control fingers. The hand robot arm geometry differs from x2_ultra.urdf and is not imported.
